q: Which of the following statements with respect to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) is INCORRECT?
options: India is a party to the convention.

explanation: CITES is legally binding on its Parties (though it does not replace national laws), so 'not legally binding' is the incorrect statement; it entered into force in 1975 and India is a Party.

q:
Consider the following statements regarding Conference of Parties to the Convention on the Conservation on Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS COP14):
I. The 14th session of CMS COP14 was held from 12th to 17th February, 2024 at Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
II. The CMS COP14 was convened under the slogan " Migratory species connect the planet and we welcome them home ".
III. CMS COP14 was the first global biodiversity gathering since the adoption of the Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF) 2022. Which among the above statements are correct?
explanation: CMS COP14 was held at Samarkand, Uzbekistan, 12–17 February 2024 and was the first global biodiversity COP after the Kunming-Montreal GBF, so I and III are right; its theme was 'Nature knows no borders', so II is wrong. (CMS itself called COP14 'one of the most significant global biodiversity gatherings since' the GBF; II is wrong in any case, so 'I and III' is the only fitting option.)

notes.text: - **CMS COP14:** **Samarkand, Uzbekistan, 12–17 Feb 2024**; theme **"Nature knows no borders"** (not "Migratory species connect the planet…"); the **first global biodiversity COP after the Kunming-Montreal GBF**. **COP15: Campo Grande, Brazil**.
